description: Tidy an existing network into a readable left→right data-flow layout, or use layout_mode=explicit for one bounded, atomic exact-coordinate mutation with stale-context checks, readback and rollback. Annotation-aware automatic layout remains available, and omission of layout_mode preserves the legacy response. It never adds, deletes, or rewires nodes.

annotation_aware.description: Treat each annotation and the operators it encloses as one layout unit. Uses structured bridge routes and never raw Python.

annotation_padding.description: Padding in network-editor units when resize_annotations is enabled.

idempotency_key.description: Explicit mode only: stable response-loss recovery key.

include_docked.description: Move each node's docked DATs (e.g. GLSL *_pixel or callbacks DATs) with it by the same delta, like an interactive drag. Set false to reposition only the nodes themselves.

layout_mode.description: Keep automatic layout by default, or place exact coordinates atomically.

path.description: COMP whose children to arrange, e.g. '/project1' or a container path.

positions.description: Explicit mode only: normalized absolute child path to exact [x, y] coordinates.

recursive.description: Also arrange the nodes inside nested COMPs (each network is tidied on its own).

resize_annotations.description: With annotation_aware, resize non-empty annotation bounds to the enclosed content plus annotation_padding.

target_source.description: Explicit mode only: use the supplied paths or compare them with active selection.

name: arrange_network
title: Arrange network layout
